title: gp-scuderia runner task file
description: Input to a framework runner: which goldens to run. The runner reads each golden's own x-reference.Xnew.

schema.description: /2 is /1 plus the optional per-task operations list; /3 adds the bound and psi operations (CIP-0006). Every /1 and /2 file is also a valid /3 file.

golden.description: Path to the golden (JSON twin for Octave and R runners)

timing.description: Optional. Time the evaluation (build model from the golden, log likelihood and prediction): one cold call, then warmup untimed calls, then repeats timed calls. The result then carries timing.

operations.description: Optional (contract /2). Default is [log_likelihood, predict]. gradient returns d log likelihood / d each wire parameter, keyed by its path in the wire tree, in wire units. A task asking only for gradient returns only gradient. bound (latent-variable models, CIP-0006) returns bound_without_kl and kl separately; psi returns the psi statistics psi0 (n), psi1 (n x m) and psi2 (m x m, summed over n). bound and psi, like gradient, must be requested on their own.
